stories.title: India to export 654MW of power to flood-hit Nepal daily till Dec 31

en.title: India to export 654MW of power to flood-hit Nepal daily till Dec 31
en.summary: India will supply 654 megawatts of electricity daily to Nepal until the end of December to assist the flood-affected nation.

stories.title: Govt. bars bank charges on payments up to ₹2,000 via UPI, RuPay-powered debit cards

en.title: Govt. bars bank charges on payments up to ₹2,000 via UPI, RuPay-powered debit cards
en.summary: The government amended payment regulations to prohibit banks from charging fees on digital transactions up to 2,000 rupees made through UPI and RuPay debit cards.

en.title: Jarange-Patil vows to take Maratha quota fight to Mumbai; 10 people, two ambulances to accompany him on Sept. 15
en.summary: An activist plans to stage a protest in Mumbai on September 15 regarding Maratha reservation with a small delegation, despite the Chief Minister's concerns about timing during a festival.

en.title: BJP single-largest party in Rajasthan urban polls, denied sweep by Independents
en.summary: The BJP won the most seats in Rajasthan's urban elections but failed to achieve a dominant victory due to strong performances by independent candidates and Congress in several towns.

en.title: Trump Administration To Scrap Carbon Emission Limits From Power Plants
en.summary: The Trump administration plans to remove carbon emission restrictions that currently apply to power plants. August was recorded as the warmest month globally.

en.title: Rajasthan urban local body poll results: Victory of truth over echo of falsehood, PM Modi says
en.summary: The BJP outperformed Congress in Rajasthan's urban local body elections, winning 4,179 wards compared to Congress's 3,613, and achieved majorities in four of ten municipal corporations.

stories.title: ‘Same govt had closed the case’: Supriya questions fresh CBI probe into Disha's death

en.title: 'Same govt had closed the case': Supriya questions fresh CBI probe into Disha's death
en.summary: The CBI opened a new investigation into Disha Salian's death following a court order, despite the case being previously closed. The matter has drawn scrutiny from political figures concerned about its politicization.

en.title: Maratha quota march: Activist Jarange to enter Mumbai with just 4-5 aides
en.summary: Activist Jarange plans to proceed to Mumbai with minimal accompaniment for a Maratha quota march after police denied protest permission and the chief minister urged reconsideration.

stories.title: 'Triumph of truth over jhooth ki goonj': PM Modi hails BJP win in Raj civic polls

en.title: 'Triumph of truth over jhooth ki goonj': PM Modi hails BJP win in Raj civic polls
en.summary: The BJP secured a significant victory in Rajasthan's municipal elections, winning majorities in four of ten municipal corporations and emerging as the largest party. Prime Minister Modi attributed the results to public approval of the party's development policies.

stories.title: BJP Emerges Ahead Of Congress In Rajasthan's Urban Local Body Polls

en.title: BJP Emerges Ahead Of Congress In Rajasthan's Urban Local Body Polls
en.summary: The BJP won 53 of the 80 wards available in Udaipur during Rajasthan's urban local body elections.

stories.title: Rajasthan Urban Local Body polls results: BJP secures 4 of 10 municipal corporations; Congress blames ‘unfair’ delimitation

en.title: Rajasthan Urban Local Body polls results: BJP secures 4 of 10 municipal corporations; Congress blames 'unfair' delimitation
en.summary: The BJP won four of ten municipal corporations in Rajasthan's urban polls. Congress secured majority in Bikaner and won in Jhalawar Municipal Council, while attributing the overall outcome to delimitation practices.

stories.title: In Rajasthan civic polls, BJP edges out Congress; Independents win on CM turf

en.title: In Rajasthan civic polls, BJP edges out Congress; Independents win on CM turf
en.summary: The BJP narrowly defeated Congress in Rajasthan municipal elections, while independent candidates secured victories in the Chief Minister's constituency.

stories.title: Can Rs 6.6 lakh crore in potential PSU divestments bring FPIs back to Indian markets? Axis Capital explains

en.title: Can Rs 6.6 lakh crore in potential PSU divestments bring FPIs back to Indian markets? Axis Capital explains
en.summary: Axis Capital suggests that accelerated government divestments of public sector units could expand India's equity investment opportunities, reduce valuation pressures, and stem foreign investor outflows. A 15% reduction in state ownership could generate Rs 6.6 lakh crore while supporting fiscal goals and improving market liquidity.

stories.title: BofA turns bullish on Nifty after 2 years, cautious on small, midcaps. Here's what it expects now

en.title: BofA turns bullish on Nifty after 2 years, cautious on small, midcaps. Here's what it expects now
en.summary: Bank of America Securities has adopted a constructive stance on the Nifty index after two years, projecting 12% upside to 26,200 by December 2026. The firm remains concerned about primary market activity, Federal Reserve rate adjustments, and AI-related disruptions, while becoming cautious on smaller and mid-sized company stocks.

stories.title: TRUSTMF Small Cap and HSBC Midcap among top 7 equity mutual funds that delivered over 20% returns in 1 year. Do you own any?

en.title: TRUSTMF Small Cap and HSBC Midcap among top 7 equity mutual funds that delivered over 20% returns in 1 year. Do you own any?
en.summary: Seven equity mutual funds generated returns exceeding 20% over one year, with TRUSTMF Small Cap Fund leading at 32.28% gain. Five small-cap funds ranked among top performers, though most of the broader fund universe posted negative returns during the period.

stories.title: HDFC Bank shares hit 52-week lows over consecutive sessions while analysts scream Buy. Has the stock hit its bottom?

en.title: HDFC Bank shares hit 52-week lows over consecutive sessions while analysts scream Buy. Has the stock hit its bottom?
en.summary: HDFC Bank shares have reached fresh 52-week lows despite multiple 'Buy' recommendations from brokerages citing attractive valuations and margin improvement potential. Weak technical indicators, however, create uncertainty about whether the stock has bottomed.

stories.title: India beats a hasty retreat from a crucial market reform

en.title: India beats a hasty retreat from a crucial market reform
en.summary: India's securities market regulator is reconsidering a closing auction reform meant to prevent price manipulation after encountering volatility and investor resistance. Underlying structural issues including high transaction taxes, limited arbitrage capacity, weak market depth, and short-selling constraints, coupled with poor policy coordination, have complicated reform implementation.
